pages.text: There is something in the air down here that you can almost hold. I call it Somnium, the stuff that dreams are made of. Today I learned to hold it. On that old table of stone, the one that was already waiting here as if it had been waiting for me, I bound a little of it into a ring. When it closed around my finger, I felt the whole world breathe in and out, slow and warm, and for one moment I knew exactly where every living thing around me was. It did not feel like power. It felt like belonging. I sat there for a long time afterwards, turning the ring in the glow. I did not think about home once. I only noticed that later, and it frightened me less than it should have.
